RiasecIntro.heroTitle: Decode Your Vocational DNA Through the Holland Hexagon
RiasecIntro.heroSubtitle: John Holland's theory links 6 vocational personalities with optimal career environments. Discover the unique synergies between Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, and Conventional.
RiasecIntro.quickStats: 36 Likert Items · 5–7 Mins · High Vocational Precision
RiasecIntro.philosophyDescription: The closer two dimensions are on the hexagon, the higher their psychological congruence. A 3-letter Holland Code creates an enduring vocational signature for high-impact careers.
RiasecIntro.storySubtitle: Scroll down to observe how the geometric radar morphs through each work dimension.
RiasecIntro.dimRDesc: Thrives on solving tangible problems using physical tools, hardware, machinery, or fieldwork without excessive abstraction.
RiasecIntro.dimRCareers: Robotics Engineer, Civil Engineer, Cyber Infrastructure, Pilot
RiasecIntro.dimIDesc: Driven by deep intellectual curiosity, complex data modeling, mathematical algorithms, and scientific hypothesis testing.
RiasecIntro.dimICareers: Data Scientist, AI Researcher, Medical Specialist, Bioinformatics
RiasecIntro.dimADesc: Seeks freedom of expression through visual aesthetics, narrative craft, conceptual design, and non-linear problem-solving.
RiasecIntro.dimACareers: UI/UX Designer, Creative Director, Game Designer, Motion Artist
RiasecIntro.dimSDesc: Possesses high emotional intelligence to mentor, teach, heal, and foster thriving, supportive communities.
RiasecIntro.dimSCareers: Career Psychologist, General Practitioner, HR Consultant, Educator
RiasecIntro.dimEDesc: Confidently leads people, negotiates high-value business deals, embraces calculated financial risks, and drives team vision.
RiasecIntro.dimECareers: Product Manager, Tech Founder, Investment Banker, VP Sales
RiasecIntro.dimCDesc: Ensures operational excellence through systematic data administration, compliance audits, meticulous financial workflows, and standardized processes.
RiasecIntro.dimCCareers: Financial Analyst, Compliance Officer, Cloud Ops Auditor, Database Admin
RiasecIntro.synergySubtitle: Adjacent dimension combinations generate formidable career advantages in an era of AI and digital transformation.
RiasecIntro.ctaTitle: Ready to Map Your Hexagonal Career Signature?
RiasecIntro.ctaSubtitle: Take the 36-question Likert assessment to unlock your personalized Holland Hexagon radar and precision career recommendations.

MbtiStory.chapter01Item3Desc: Drawing internal energy from deep solitude or collective social dynamics.
